Jenkinsfile deploy-time backup hook
nodes.rationale: Deploy-time backup alone is insufficient since it only runs when someone deploys; wired into Jenkinsfile so every deploy is preceded by a backup.

nodes.label: Nightly cron backup schedule
nodes.rationale: Deploy-time backups alone are not enough because data accumulated since the last deploy would otherwise be unprotected; a nightly cron entry must still be added manually on the Jenkins host.

nodes.label: Backup restore drill practice
nodes.rationale: An untested backup is a guess; running a scratch restore and timing it establishes confidence and a known recovery time before a real incident.

nodes.label: Flutter CI analyze-and-test pipeline
nodes.rationale: CI-001: the repo previously had no CI, so nothing checked a change before merge. Build/release steps are deliberately excluded since signing keys and store credentials belong to the release pipeline owner, not this file. The analyze step gates only on error/warning-level lints because ~316 pre-existing info-level lints (mostly deprecated withOpacity and use_build_context_synchronously) would fail every build from day one; --no-fatal-infos alone is insufficient since flutter analyze still exits non-zero on any issue, so severity is checked explicitly via grep.
